16200.name: Outside A Large Cabin

east.description: To the east lies On A Mountain Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Front Door Hall.

16200.description:
A large log cabin squats on a bare shoulder of hillside, its walls grey
with weather and its shutters nailed fast. A narrow path winds east into
the mist toward the high mountain path. The grass here grows in pale,
wrong tufts, and no bird sings anywhere. A heavy door in the cabin wall
stands a little ajar to the south, and the roofline leans like a thing
that is listening.

16201.name: In A Dimly Lit Library

east.description: To the east lies The Front Door Hall.

16201.description:
Shelves of dark wood climb to the ceiling and beyond it, so that the
highest rows are lost in shadow, and a ladder leans against them with
its feet on nothing. A reading desk stands in the middle of the floor
with a lantern burning low upon it. The books smell of damp leather and
old ink. The door east leads back to the hall, though from here it looks
smaller than it should.

16202.name: The Front Door Hall

north.description: To the north lies Outside A Large Cabin.

east.description: To the east lies In The Livingroom.

south.description: To the south lies The South Part Of The Hall.

west.description: To the west lies In A Dimly Lit Library.

16202.description:
A narrow front hall of dark pine boards, hung with coat pegs that hold
only shadows. The floor is polished so smooth that the lamplight slides
along it like oil. A door north opens back onto the hillside, a door
east leads to a living room, and another west into a library, while the
hall itself goes on south. The beams overhead sit a hand's breadth too
low at one end and too high at the other.

16203.name: In The Livingroom

west.description: To the west lies The Front Door Hall.

16203.description:
A broad living room with a cold hearth of fieldstone and chairs drawn up
around it as though for a gathering that never came. The chairs have too
many legs for their size, or too few, and your eye will not settle on
which. A threadbare rug lies under dust as thick as felt. The only way
out is the door back west into the hall.

16204.name: The Kitchen

east.description: To the east lies The South Part Of The Hall.

16204.description:
A cold iron range fills one wall of this kitchen, its pots hanging above
in rows from hooks, all swaying very slightly although the air is still.
A pail of black water stands by the hearth and holds the reflection of a
ceiling that is not above you. The tiles underfoot are greasy and
uneven. The only way out is the door east, back into the hall.

16205.name: The South Part Of The Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Front Door Hall.

east.description: To the east lies In The Bedroom.

south.description: To the south lies In A Room Filled With Mirrors.

west.description: To the west lies The Kitchen.

16205.description:
The hall bends here into its lower reach, where the floorboards run
crosswise to the ones behind you and the lamps burn a dull orange. Doors
stand east and west, one to a bedroom and one to a kitchen, and a third
door south gives onto a room that glitters. The front of the hall lies
north. The wallpaper repeats a pattern of tiny closed eyes, and the
quiet in this place seems to lean toward you.

16206.name: In The Bedroom

west.description: To the west lies The South Part Of The Hall.

16206.description:
A bedroom with a tall bed hung in rotting curtains, its coverlet pulled
smooth as if no one had ever slept in it. The wardrobe stands against
the wall at a tilt that should send it crashing down, yet it does not. A
candle stub has melted into the sill in a long pale tongue, and the
window shows only a flat grey that is not sky. The door west is the only
way back to the hall.

16207.name: In A Room Filled With Mirrors

north.description: To the north lies The South Part Of The Hall.

south.description: To the south lies In A Room Filled With Mirrors.

16207.description:
Mirrors cover every wall, the ceiling and even the floor, set in black
frames that crowd edge to edge. Your reflection steps a moment after you
do, and the room beyond the glass is always longer than the one you
stand in. A pale doorway lies north, back to the hall, and an identical
one waits south. You cannot tell which of the two reflected doors is the
real one.

16208.name: In A Room Filled With Mirrors

north.description: To the north lies The South Part Of The Hall.

south.description: To the south lies In A Room Filled With Mirrors.

16208.description:
Mirrors again, but cracked now, each pane showing a different slice of
the room and none of them whole. A fine red dust lies in the cracks like
dried wine. The door north leads out, though in the glass you see it
standing on every side at once. South the chamber seems to go on,
folding back upon itself until it ends where it began.

16209.name: The Kitchen

east.description: To the east lies The South Part Of The Hall.

16209.description:
A kitchen of stone, with a sink worn hollow and a pump whose spout drips
a thin red thread that never fills the basin. Shelves hold jars of
something pale and cloudy, each sealed with wax. A long table is scored
with knife cuts, laid in patterns that look like maps. The door east
returns you to the hall, and the smell of vinegar follows you out.

16210.name: The South Part Of The Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Front Door Hall.

east.description: To the east lies In The Bedroom.

south.description: To the south lies In A Room Filled With Mirrors.

west.description: To the west lies The Kitchen.

16210.description:
This stretch of the hall is a second copy of the first, but wrong in
small ways: the lamps hang on the left wall instead of the right, and
the boards smell of cold ash. Doors stand east and west, one to a
bedroom and one to a kitchen. The hall runs north toward a front door,
and south an open archway shows a pale glimmer of glass. Somewhere a
clock ticks, backward, you would swear.

16211.name: In The Bedroom

west.description: To the west lies The South Part Of The Hall.

16211.description:
A narrow room with a narrow bed, its blanket folded in thirds and its
pillow dented by a head that has not been there for years. A looking
glass on the dresser has been turned to face the wall. A trunk stands at
the foot of the bed with its lid shut and its lock bright as new. The
door west leads back to the hall.

16212.name: In A Dimly Lit Library

east.description: To the east lies The Front Door Hall.

16212.description:
Shelves rise in a spiral from the floor, curving around the room so that
the volumes seem to lead you in while the door recedes. Every book is
bound in grey cloth with no title, and when you open one the pages are
blank. A single candle in a dish gives a light just strong enough to
show how dim it is. The only door lies east, back to the hall.

16213.name: The Front Door Hall

north.description: To the north lies Outside A Large Cabin.

east.description: To the east lies In The Livingroom.

south.description: To the south lies The South Part Of The Hall.

west.description: To the west lies In A Dimly Lit Library.

16213.description:
The front hall again, narrower than before, and its pegs are hung with
long grey cloaks that keep their shape with nobody inside them. A door
north opens on a covered threshold, a door east on the living room, and
a door west on the library. The hall continues south. The floor tilts a
few degrees to one side, and cold air creeps beneath every door.

16214.name: In The Livingroom

west.description: To the west lies The Front Door Hall.

16214.description:
A second living room, larger than the first and twice as empty, with a
sofa whose cushions have sunk into hollows that no one has filled.
Picture frames cover one wall, each holding only a pale rectangle where
a picture used to be. A clock on the mantel has no hands, and yet it
ticks. The door west leads to the hall.

16215.name: Outside A Large Cabin

north.description: To the north lies On A Path Of Bones.

south.description: To the south lies The Front Door Hall.

16215.description:
A narrow vestibule roofed in blackened boards, where the cabin's outer
wall seems to have turned itself inside out. Lamp brackets jut from the
planks at the height of your knee, and the floor is worn into a shallow
trough by feet you cannot picture. The door south leads back into the
front hall. Northward the vestibule opens on a road of pale, glinting
bone.

16216.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

south.description: To the south lies Outside A Large Cabin.

16216.description:
The path begins in earnest here, a road laid of skulls set jaw to jaw,
thousands of them, polished by weather to the colour of old teeth. It
comes up from the cabin porch to the south and turns to run east across
a plain of broken grey ground. The sky above is the flat red of a wound
closing. Every skull faces the same way, and it is not toward you.

16217.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16217.description:
Thigh bones, long and yellow, are laid side by side in a herringbone,
each end driven into the earth so that the path rings faintly hollow
beneath your tread. On either hand the ground is cracked into grey
plates with nothing growing in the seams. The way runs on east, and
behind you it bends back west toward the cabin. A smell of old cellars
rises through the gaps.

16218.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16218.description:
Great curved ribcages have been planted along the road in pairs, arching
over it like the ribs of some vast ruined hall. Between them the paving
is a mosaic of vertebrae, each knob worn smooth by passing feet. A thin
wind threads the arches and makes a whistling that is almost a tune. The
path goes on east, and the arches lead back west.

16219.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies Junction Of Bone.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16219.description:
Bone dust lies ankle deep over the paving here, fine and white as flour,
and rises in slow clouds at every step. Faint tracks of other travellers
show in it, then fill and vanish. Ahead the road widens toward a
crossing, and the dust blows across it in long pale ribbons. West the
way goes back toward the arches, a dry rattle trailing after you.

16220.name: Junction Of Bone

north.description: To the north lies On A Path Of Bones.

south.description: To the south lies A Break In The Path.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16220.description:
Four roads of bone meet here, though one of them has fallen away, and at
the crossing a wheel of skulls has been set into the ground with the
eyes all turned inward. Black cracks run out from the wheel like spokes.
A path runs north, another south toward a gap in the paving, and the one
you came by lies west. The hum you felt in your teeth is louder at this
crossing.

16221.name: On A Path Of Bones

north.description: To the north lies Junction Of Bone.

south.description: To the south lies Junction Of Bone.

16221.description:
A single spine, a monstrous one, has been laid lengthwise down the
middle of the road, its great knuckled links forming a raised ridge that
you must step over. On either side lie scattered ribs, broken short. The
ground beyond is a dead grey crust that crackles under the wind. The
road runs north to another crossing and south to the one behind you.

16222.name: Junction Of Bone

north.description: To the north lies On A Path Of Bones.

south.description: To the south lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16222.description:
A crossing of bone pavements, rutted and sunken, where a thick black
pillar leans out of the broken ground at an angle that should have
toppled it long ago. The pillar hums, a low note that you feel in your
belly rather than hear. Paths run north and south, and a third leads
west under a drift of knucklebones. Dust lies in unmoving heaps on the
pillar's windless side.

16223.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies Junction Of Bone.

west.description: To the west lies A Baffling Sight.

16223.description:
Knucklebones lie scattered over the road like dice thrown by a careless
giant, and some of them roll a little when you are not looking. A
crossing of bone pavements lies east, and the odd, shimmering sight is
back west. Beside the path a low outcrop of black rock sweats a dark
moisture into a runnel of dust. Overhead the sky is the colour of a
bruise fading.

16224.name: A Baffling Sight

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16224.description:
A baffling sight meets you here: the road ahead seems to climb and to
fall at once, and the horizon shows twice, one above the other like a
reflection hung in the air. A black pillar stands far off, upside down,
its point resting on the ground. The bones in the paving lie in patterns
that your eye reads as a face, then as a map, then as nothing at all.
The path runs east and west.

16225.name: On A Path Of Bones

north.description: To the north lies On A Path Of Bones.

east.description: To the east lies A Baffling Sight.

16225.description:
Small skulls, none bigger than a fist, have been mortared into low banks
on both sides of the path, rank upon rank of hollow stares. The road
itself is bare packed earth worn smooth, as if the bones were saved for
the walls. North the path climbs back toward a bend, and east it
descends toward a place where the view goes strange. A chill moves along
the ground and does not rise.

16226.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

south.description: To the south lies On A Path Of Bones.

16226.description:
At this corner the road is paved with pelvic bones, wide and winged,
fitted together like the plates of a great shell. In a hollow beside the
verge a shallow pool of red water lies perfectly still, and no wind
ripples it. One path leads east along the bone road and another south
toward a lower stretch of broken ground. The air tastes faintly of iron.

16227.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16227.description:
The paving is made of finger bones, millions of them, set on end in
tight whorls so that the road looks tiled in pale grass. Walking on it
raises a dry whispering like wheat in a breeze. Cracked black earth
shows to either hand, dotted with thorn stumps that have never borne a
leaf. The path runs east and west, and the same whisper follows you both
ways.

16228.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16228.description:
Tusks and curving horns have been set upright at the edges of the path,
a crooked guard of ivory that bristles on either hand. The paving
between them is flat shoulder blades, laid like scales, rocking a little
underfoot. The road runs east toward a bend and west toward another
stretch of the same. A smell of old copper hangs over everything.

16229.name: On A Path Of Bones

south.description: To the south lies Junction Of Bone.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16229.description:
The road turns a corner here between low heaps of jawbones, thousands of
them, stacked with the teeth outward like rows of tiny fence posts. Grey
grass pokes through them in wiry tufts. One path leads south toward a
crossing and the other west along the bone road. The sky is a smear of
rust and soot, and nothing at all crosses it.

16230.name: A Break In The Path

north.description: To the north lies Junction Of Bone.

south.description: To the south lies Path Of Bones.

16230.description:
The bone paving has been torn up here, leaving a long wound of bare red
clay across the road. Bones lie in heaps at its edges as though thrown
aside in haste. Rust-coloured water wells slowly into the deepest part
of the gap. The road resumes at a crossing north of here, and a stretch
of bone continues south beyond the clay.

16231.name: Path Of Bones

north.description: To the north lies A Break In The Path.

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

16231.description:
The road turns a corner here, paved with teeth set in black mortar,
molars and fangs in rows, like an enormous mouth lying open to the sky.
A shallow ditch runs along one side, filled with grey slag. The path
leads north to a break in the paving and bends away east. A thin high
humming runs through the ground and sets the teeth in your head buzzing.

16232.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies Path Of Bones.

16232.description:
On each side stand shin bones driven upright in two close rows, a
palisade of pale stakes as high as your waist. Between them the road is
laid with long ribs lying flat, rattling underfoot. A low mist clings to
the ground and hides your boots. The path leads east and west between
the rows, narrow and straight.

16233.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16233.description:
Every skull in the pavement here has an iron nail driven through its
brow, rusted red, so that the ground looks freckled with old blood.
Black thorn bushes crowd the margins, twisted into the shapes of
reaching hands. East and west the road runs on, straight and hard. No
sound rises from it but the tick of your own steps.

16234.name: On A Path Of Bones

south.description: To the south lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16234.description:
At this bend antlers have been woven into a low barricade along the
outer edge, their tines locked together like fingers. The paving is a
rubble of hip and shoulder bones, loose and treacherous. A pool of dark
stagnant water fills a hollow, and it mirrors a sky of a different
colour than the one overhead. The path turns south, while west leads
back along the road.

16235.name: On A Path Of Bones

north.description: To the north lies On A Path Of Bones.

east.description: To the east lies A Break In The Path.

16235.description:
Curling horns have been set into the road like rosettes, one at every
pace, and small bones fill the gaps between them. A low ridge of black
rock has risen here out of the broken ground and hides the view. The
road comes in from the north and bends away east toward a break in the
paving. Cold dew beads on the bone and runs into the cracks.

16236.name: A Break In The Path

east.description: To the east lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16236.description:
The road has sunk into a shallow pit, its bones slumped and half buried
in silt the colour of dried blood. Planks of bleached wood are laid
across the worst of it, creaking and bowing when you step. East the bone
paving resumes on firmer ground. West it runs back toward a corner, and
a dry wind pushes dust down the length of the pit.

16237.name: On A Path Of Bones

north.description: To the north lies On A Path Of Bones.

west.description: To the west lies A Break In The Path.

16237.description:
Collarbones, thin and curved, lie in overlapping rows like roof slates,
and they click like shingles under your tread. A black pillar stands a
little way off the verge, taller than a house, humming so steadily that
the dust trembles in time. The road turns here, leading north toward a
straight stretch and west to a sunken place. Something in the air makes
your skin crawl.

16238.name: On A Path Of Bones

north.description: To the north lies On A Path Of Bones.

south.description: To the south lies On A Path Of Bones.

16238.description:
A straight stretch of road runs between two long ditches filled with
bone dust, and beyond them rise black pillars at even spaces, each as
thick as an oak and humming on a different note. Together the notes make
a slow chord that presses on your ears. The path leads north toward a
gate and south back along the bone road. Nothing moves in the pale haze.

16239.name: On A Path Of Bones

east.description: To the east lies Outside A Deformed Gate.

south.description: To the south lies On A Path Of Bones.

16239.description:
The road ends in a circle of paving made of skulls, every one turned
inward, while the way ahead is blocked by a wall of pale stone that
rises crooked against the sky. A gate stands east, tall and leaning, and
its shadow falls across the bones. The path you came by lies south. The
humming is loud here, and the stone seems to answer it.

16240.name: Outside A Deformed Gate

east.description: To the east lies Inside The Deformed Gate.

west.description: To the west lies On A Path Of Bones.

16240.description:
A deformed gate rises before you, its arch pinched at one side and
swollen at the other, the posts of unequal thickness and neither one
quite upright. The doorway beneath it is too narrow at the top and too
wide at the bottom, as though drawn by a child. Beyond it the walls of a
vast pale building lean away with windows of every size. The bone road
lies west, and the gate opens east.

16241.name: Inside The Deformed Gate

north.description: To the north lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Of Pillars.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

west.description: To the west lies Outside A Deformed Gate.

16241.description:
Just inside the gate, the passage opens into a cramped chamber where the
walls lean together overhead and the floor slopes toward one corner.
Corridors run along the outer wall north and south, and a wide archway
on the east side opens onto a hall of pillars. The gate you came through
lies west. Lamplight pools on the flags and then somehow fails to light
the rest.

16242.name: Along The Wall Of The Building

north.description: To the north lies Inside The Deformed Gate.

east.description: To the east lies By A Door In The Wall.

16242.description:
Two walls meet in a corner that is not a right angle, and the floor has
been laid to follow it in a long spreading wedge of flagstones. The gate
chamber lies north. A door in the wall waits east. A shelf of grey stone
is built into the plaster at about the height of your chest, with
nothing on it but a ring of old soot.

16243.name: By A Door In The Wall

north.description: To the north lies Hall Of Pillars.

east.description: To the east lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

south.description: To the south lies By A Mindboggling, Winding Staircase.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

16243.description:
A door of black wood stands in the wall here, set so that it seems to
lean out into the passage. Dust lies on the lintel in a perfect layer,
as if nothing had touched it since the building was dreamed. The hall of
pillars lies north, a corridor runs east and west along the wall, and
south the door opens on a winding stair. A cold wind comes under it,
though the air elsewhere is still.

16244.name: Along The Wall Of The Building

north.description: To the north lies Hall Of Pillars.

east.description: To the east lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

west.description: To the west lies By A Door In The Wall.

16244.description:
A single smoking lamp hangs here from a chain that rises into darkness
without ever reaching a ceiling. Its light shows a corridor of cold
plaster, with the hall of pillars opening to the north and the passage
running on east and west. The floor is worn into two shallow grooves, as
though a cart had passed again and again. A smell of tallow and damp
stone clings to the air.

16245.name: Along The Wall Of The Building

north.description: To the north lies By A Large Decorated Door In The Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

16245.description:
The passage ends in a blunt corner of plaster stained with long dark
runs, as if the wall itself had wept. North the corridor reaches a large
decorated door, and west it runs back along the wall. The corner is not
square, and when you stand in it your shoulder feels a gentle pressure.
Somewhere a dripping counts out a slow, uneven time.

16246.name: By A Large Decorated Door In The Wall

north.description: To the north lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

east.description: To the east lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Of Pillars.

16246.description:
A large decorated door stands in the wall here, carved with coiling
shapes that begin as vines and end as writhing hands. It is set at an
angle to the wall and yet seems flush with it. The corridor runs north
and south alongside, and the hall of pillars opens west. The door itself
leads east to a red and ruined shore, and a faint smell of blood comes
through the planks.

16247.name: Along The Wall Of The Building

south.description: To the south lies By A Large Decorated Door In The Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

16247.description:
The corridor bends along the wall, where the floor is paved in black and
white tiles that do not make a pattern but only a mess. Candles gutter
in niches, burning with flames that stand perfectly straight. A large
decorated door lies south, and the corridor runs back west the way it
came. The tiles at your feet seem to shift when watched.

16248.name: Along The Wall Of The Building

east.description: To the east lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Of Pillars.

west.description: To the west lies By A Door In The Wall.

16248.description:
The outer corridor passes here beneath a row of narrow slit windows
through which you can see only more wall. The plaster is damp and cold,
and it smells of wet stone and old wax. East and west the passage
continues along the wall, and a gap in the south side opens on the hall
of pillars. A small draught moves, though no door is open.

16249.name: By A Door In The Wall

north.description: To the north lies By A Mindboggling, Winding Staircase.

east.description: To the east lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Of Pillars.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

16249.description:
A heavy door of black wood is set in the wall here, its handle at an
awkward height and its hinges on the wrong side. The corridor runs east
and west along the wall, and south a wide opening shows the columns of a
great hall. North, a door leads to a place where the stairs wind. The
floor is laid in flags of every size, none matching.

16250.name: Along The Wall Of The Building

east.description: To the east lies By A Door In The Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Deformed Gate.

16250.description:
A narrow passage runs along the outer wall of the building, whose
plaster is scored with long scratches in groups of five. The ceiling is
lower than it should be, and the lamps in their iron brackets throw
crooked shadows. East the corridor continues toward a door set in the
wall, and south it returns to the gate chamber. Your own steps come back
from the wrong direction.

16251.name: Hall Of Pillars

north.description: To the north lies By A Door In The Wall.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Of Pillars.

south.description: To the south lies By A Door In The Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Inside The Deformed Gate.

16251.description:
Black columns thick as ancient trees rise in rows from the floor into a
ceiling lost in gloom, and each one hums its own low note. The floor
between them is smooth and faintly warm, like the flank of a sleeping
thing. Doors lie north and south among the columns, the hall goes on
east, and west a leaning arch opens toward the gate chamber. Your voice
dies a pace from your lips.

16252.name: Hall Of Pillars

north.description: To the north lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

east.description: To the east lies By A Large Decorated Door In The Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Wall Of The Building.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Of Pillars.

16252.description:
More pillars, but these stand crooked and unequal, some no thicker than
a man's arm and others broad as a cart, and a few lean on their
neighbours like tired drunks. Their surfaces are marked with scratches
that might be letters. Passages open north and south toward the wall
corridors, a large decorated door lies east, and the forest of columns
goes on west. The hum swells and fades like breathing.

16253.name: By A Mindboggling, Winding Staircase

south.description: To the south lies By A Door In The Wall.

up.description: To the up lies Outside A Large Cabin.

16253.description:
A mindboggling staircase winds up from here, its steps turning in a
spiral that seems to climb and drop at once, and each turn looks back on
the last. Wooden rails are bolted to walls that bulge outward in places
and sink in others. Far above, a square of grey light promises a way
out, and the stair leads there. The door south opens back to the
corridor of the wall.

16254.name: By A Mindboggling, Winding Staircase

north.description: To the north lies By A Door In The Wall.

16254.description:
The winding staircase that began behind the door has been walled in, its
steps vanishing under smooth plaster at the first turn. Chisel marks
cross the plaster in anxious lines, as if someone had tried to dig back
in. The air is close and smells of wet lime. The only way out is the
door north into the wall passage.

16255.name: On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies By A Large Decorated Door In The Wall.

16255.description:
The door in the wall opens on a ridge of dark gravel, and beyond it a
lake of red water laps without a sound. The sky above is a low, bruised
copper, and the air carries a warm smell like a butcher's yard. A shore
runs north and south along the water's edge, while to the east the lake
spreads away, thick and slow. The wall of the building towers behind you
to the west.

16256.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

16256.description:
Pale bubbles rise at intervals through the red water, and each breaks
with a small flat sound like a sigh. The raft turns a half circle and
settles again, its logs creaking. Not far west a dark shingle slopes up
from the lake, and the wall above it is a blind grey cliff. The lake
runs on north, south and east, quiet and enormous under the copper sky.

16257.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On A Small Island In The Middle Of The Lake.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16257.description:
The water here is shallow enough that you see, far below, the pale
shapes of rocks standing on the lake bed like the stumps of a ruined
town. Red mist drifts across the surface in slow rafts of its own. An
island lies near, to the east, a low heap of stone in the haze. North,
south and west the lake spreads away, and nothing moves on it.

16258.name: On A Small Island In The Middle Of The Lake

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

down.description: To the down lies City Limits Of Ghenna.

16258.description:
The raft grinds ashore on a small island in the middle of the lake, a
knoll of grey stone and dead thorn rising a few paces above the red
water. The ground is cracked and pitted, and in its centre a ragged
mouth opens between the rocks, with rough steps cut down into the dark.
A warm, stale breath rises from it, smelling of ash and old bones, and
the stair leads down toward a ruined city far below. The lake lies all
around, and the swell runs away in every direction.

16259.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On A Small Island In The Middle Of The Lake.

16259.description:
Close at hand to the west a low island rises from the red water, a rough
knoll of grey stones with a few dead thorns on its crown. Ripples wander
out from its edge in perfect rings, though nothing causes them. The lake
lies open to the north and south, and eastward a bank of broken rock
slopes into the swell. The air smells of rust and cold ash.

16260.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16260.description:
A heavy swell lifts the raft and sets it down, and the red water beneath
looks thick enough to walk on. The stony bank lies close at hand east,
and above it the sky glows a dull copper. A trail of pale froth
stretches away across the surface, behind the raft. North, south and
west the lake goes on.

16261.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16261.description:
Rocks like a broken stair lead down to the lake, and half-buried among
them lie the great curved ribs of something that died here long ago,
their tips sticking up like the masts of a wreck. The red water breaks
against them in slow, oily folds. The shore runs north and south along
the water, and the lake lies west, wide and utterly still. The wind
carries a taste of rust.

16262.name: On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies By A Huge Black Pillar.

16262.description:
A strip of grey shingle runs between the building's blind wall and the
lake, and the red water clicks against it in tiny waves. Dead reeds lean
over the margin, their tips dipped in blood-coloured scum. The shore
leads north toward the door and south to a dark pillar. To the east the
water opens, still and wide, under a copper sky.

16263.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

16263.description:
Under the raft the lake is utterly silent, and the red surface reflects
the sky with a stain of its own, so that the heavens look cut and
bleeding. West a wide strip of grey shingle runs up to a wall of pale
stone, and south a bank of black rocks curves in. The swell is slow and
long. North and east the water stretches into haze.

16264.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16264.description:
The raft drifts on a patch of water that is paler than the rest, a
pinkish shade like weak wine, and in it floats a ring of tiny pale
bubbles that circles without stopping. To the south the rocks of the
bank rise near and sharp. North, east and west the lake spreads, wide
and quiet. A faint hum shivers through the logs.

16265.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On A Small Island In The Middle Of The Lake.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16265.description:
An island lies just ahead to the north, a rough heap of stone and thorn,
and the red water laps at its edge in long sticky strokes. Behind and
around you the lake runs wide, and south the broken rocks of the bank
slope down to the water. The swell here carries a smell of old copper
and wet earth. A pale crust of salt rings the island like the line in an
empty cup.

16266.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16266.description:
The lake is darkest here, almost black, with veins of crimson running
through it like blood in a bruise. The raft moves with a slow, unwilling
sway. A stony beach rises close to the south, and the water spreads away
to the north, east and west under a low copper sky. Far across the
water, a tall pillar stands against the haze and hums.

16267.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16267.description:
Close to the raft on the east side the bank climbs in black blocks, and
a huge dark pillar towers over the far corner. The water here is warmer
than elsewhere, and a thin red steam rises from it in curling ropes.
South a stony bank lies near as well, and the lake runs on west and
north. Every few moments the swell gives a deep, slow heave.

16268.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies By A Huge Black Pillar.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16268.description:
The shore here is a litter of black glass and shattered stone, as if
lightning had once struck the ground repeatedly. Where the glass meets
the lake it has melted into long smooth shelves, glossy under a film of
red. The shore leads north to a bend and south to a dark pillar. To the
west the lake lies open and silent, and the sky above it is copper and
soot.

16269.name: By A Huge Black Pillar

north.description: To the north lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16269.description:
A huge black pillar stands at the foot of the wall, and the shingle
around its base is melted smooth into glass. The hum comes through the
soles of your boots and sets your jaw aching. A path of scattered stones
leads north along the shore and east along a rockier edge of the lake.
Beyond, far across the water, the pale hump of an island floats in the
haze.

16270.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies By A Huge Black Pillar.

16270.description:
A rubble bank of black stone, tangled with dead roots like grey knotted
rope, holds back a little bay of red water. The surface of the bay
shivers continually, though no wind stirs. A huge dark pillar stands
west, and the shore leads back east. North the lake opens and the haze
closes in, hiding the other side.

16271.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16271.description:
Here the rocks climb a little, forming a small bluff above the lake from
which the red water seems very far away and strangely flat. Pale lichen
grows on the stone in the shapes of handprints, large and small. The
shore runs east and west along the bluff's foot. North the lake extends
to a pale smudge that might be an island.

16272.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16272.description:
The shore is a low ridge of pale pebbles that clink like coins under
your feet, and between them runs a thin stream of red water, braiding
back to the lake. A bare thorn stands crooked at the margin with its
branches all bent the same way. East and west the shore goes on, while
north the lake spreads to the far haze. The air is damp and tastes of
copper.

16273.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16273.description:
A strip of blackened gravel runs between the lake and a bank of broken
ground, strewn with the splintered planks of some long-wrecked boat. The
ribs of its hull stick up from the shingle, grey and rotten. You can
follow the shore east or west, and north the lake lies still, the colour
of a fresh cut. Tiny crystals of salt glitter on the stones.

16274.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies By A Huge Black Pillar.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16274.description:
Heavy slabs of rock lie tumbled along the water here, split and
overgrown with a stiff red moss that crackles when touched. A huge black
pillar stands where the shore climbs east, and the way runs on west
across more rubble. North the lake extends, the surface smooth as a
mirror and as dark. The sound of the water is soft and lazy, like breath
in sleep.

16275.name: By A Huge Black Pillar

north.description: To the north lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16275.description:
A huge black pillar stands at the lake's lower corner, rooted in the
stones, humming a note that rises and falls with the slow swell of the
water. Its base is ringed with a cairn of small bones, heaped there by
who knows what hand. A path runs north along the rocks and west along
the bottom shore. The red water slaps against the pillar's foot and
leaves no mark.

16276.name: On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies By A Huge Black Pillar.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

16276.description:
A narrow beach of black grit slopes down to the lake, and the red water
slides over it in long, slow tongues that leave stains. Weed the colour
of liver clings to the stones. The shore runs north toward a tall dark
pillar and south back along the wall of the building. The lake itself
lies out to the east, and nothing floats on it.

16277.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

16277.description:
Your raft rides low on the Lake of Blood, and the water presses against
its logs in a thick, unhurried swell. Close by to the west the grey
shore slopes into the red, and a pale ridge of rock hides the wall
beyond it. The surface carries a skin of scum that parts ahead of the
raft and closes behind. North a rocky bank lies near, while south and
east the lake runs on.

16278.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16278.description:
The red water here is calm and heavy, and the raft turns slowly on it,
as if it could not decide which way to drift. A film of oily bubbles
gathers against the logs and pops without a sound. To the north the
rocks of the bank loom close, and to the east and south the lake goes
on, dark and unmoving. A low hum comes across the surface from the
pillars on the far bank.

16279.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On A Small Island In The Middle Of The Lake.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16279.description:
A slow current tugs the raft toward the south, where a small island
rises low from the lake, its pale stones just visible in the haze. The
water is the colour of fresh blood near the surface and of old blood
below. A rocky bank lies north, and the lake lies open east and west. A
faint steam lifts from the swell and beads on your skin.

16280.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16280.description:
The raft wallows in a hollow where the swell comes at it from two
directions at once, and the red water slaps and chuckles around the
logs. The air above is warm and sweet and sticks in your throat. North
the bank of broken rock stands a short pole's length away. East and west
the lake stretches out, and south it opens toward a wide red emptiness.

16281.name: On The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16281.description:
Here the lake narrows toward the rocks, and the raft glides through
water that is nearly black, with lazy threads of crimson turning on its
surface. The pillar at the far corner of the lake sends a slow hum
through the logs and into your boots. The bank lies close to the north
and a stony beach to the east. West and south the lake falls away in
long unbroken swells.

16282.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

north.description: To the north lies By A Huge Black Pillar.

south.description: To the south lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Lake Of Blood.

16282.description:
The ground here is a bank of dark gravel pitted with little holes, as
though the lake had breathed on it, and from the pits rises a thin red
mist. A huge black pillar stands north, close enough for its hum to
shake the grit loose. The shore runs south along the water, and to the
west the lake opens, wide and dark. A sour smell like old pennies fills
the air.

16283.name: By A Huge Black Pillar

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Shore Of A Lake Of Blood.

16283.description:
A huge black pillar rises from the broken ground at the water's edge, as
wide as a tower and taller than the eye can follow, and it hums so
deeply that the pebbles at its foot shiver. The stone is slick, as if
freshly wet, and shows no seam. The shore runs east along the lake and
south toward a gentler beach. Overhead the clouds sit low and red.

16284.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies By A Huge Black Pillar.

16284.description:
Jagged rocks, black and wet, jut out along the water's edge, and the red
lake sucks at their feet with a small clinging sound. A huge dark pillar
rises to the west, its hum running along the stones like a fever. The
shore continues east, and south the lake lies open, its surface slow and
thick. Crusted salt stains the rocks in rust-coloured rings.

16285.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16285.description:
A broken terrace of grey boulders steps down to the lake here, each slab
tilted at a different angle, so that walking it is a matter of leaping
from one to the next. Rust-red lichen coats the stone in patches that
look like old wounds. The shore leads east and west along the water, and
south the lake spreads out, still and heavy. A cold, metallic smell
rolls off the surface.

16286.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16286.description:
The rocks are smaller here, scree and shingle slick with a red film, and
they shift and clink under your boots. A dead tree, bleached and
twisted, stands at the water's lip with its roots in the lake, and its
branches dip into the red as though drinking. You can follow the shore
east or west. South the lake is wide and quiet, with a faint steam on
it.

16287.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

east.description: To the east lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16287.description:
A wide shelf of flat rock reaches out into the lake, cracked into
plates, and in the cracks stand pools of water so red they look like
spilled paint. The air here is thick and sweet. East and west the shore
runs on, and the lake lies south, motionless but for slow rings that
spread from nowhere. The sky overhead has the dull gleam of old copper.

16288.name: On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood

east.description: To the east lies By A Huge Black Pillar.

south.description: To the south lies On The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16288.description:
The shore narrows to a ledge here, hemmed on one side by broken ground
and on the other by the lake, which gnaws at the stone with a patient
lapping. A mooring post, grey and split, leans from a crack with a loop
of frayed rope still wound about it. A huge black pillar looms east
where the ledge widens, and the shore runs back west. South the lake
stretches away, dark red and still.

16289.name: By A Huge Black Pillar

south.description: To the south lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

west.description: To the west lies On The Rocky Shore Of The Lake Of Blood.

16289.description:
A huge black pillar stands at the corner of the lake, rising out of a
heap of fallen rocks, and its hum is so low that your heartbeat falls
into step with it. The surface of the stone is polished and unmarked,
and your face looks up from it, stretched. The shore runs south down the
lake's far edge and west along the rocks. A crust of dried red stains
the ground around its foot.
